provenance: co-authored (Kavik + Claude), 2026-11-03. Design: communities act locally; AI nodes match and propose; humans in each community decide. Government action is an optional parallel input, never a prerequisite. Asterisks = thin volume. Every row PROPOSED unless stated.

risks.text: Coordination drifts into control: whoever runs the AI layer becomes the new center*
in_code: consent(): only human:<role> in a party community can accept or refuse; AI cannot
node_concentration(): flags any AI node brokering > 50% of accepted exchanges*
corroborate()/single_node(): marks proposals no second node reproduced
risks.status: PARTIAL: detector + consent gate; no structural guard against capture of the human gate itself

risks.text: Channel loss: AI-to-AI links fail in outage (power, towers, spectrum)
in_code: to_paper(): one-line paper/voice form of every proposal
risks.status: PARTIAL: degraded format exists; no channel tested

risks.text: Ledger poisoning: false reports or a compromised node rewrite methods or holdings
in_code: append_log()/verify_log(): append-only sha256 chain; appends refused on a broken chain
holdings only enter through a community's own file; propose() cannot change holdings
consent() returns a new record; old record unchanged
risks.status: PARTIAL: tamper-evident, not tamper-proof; a node can still append FALSE records. No experiment listed (gap)

risks.text: Schema divergence: AIs read records differently, so trades mismatch
in_code: schema_version on every profile and proposal; propose() refuses mismatched profiles
plain_ok(): every record and log line must carry a plain-language line
risks.status: PARTIAL: version mismatch caught; same version read differently is not

risks.text: Over-reliance: humans stop keeping manual capability; AI outage means paralysis
risks.status: OPEN: nothing in code; needs drills

risks.text: Inventory exposure: shared holdings reveal who has fuel or food -> target risk*
in_code: share_profile(): only item ids held cross the wire; no holder names, quantities, locations or buffer hours
risks.status: PARTIAL: even yes/no 'holds fuel' is exposure; cost of that is unmeasured

risks.text: Compounding error across communities: one bad junction propagates network-wide
risks.status: OPEN here. Link: thermodynamic-accountability-framework assembly_instrument status.py CAUTION + checkout.py print field warnings before any method is handed on

backups.text: AI link down: same records on paper, carried by runners or read over voice radio
Node compromised: append-only hash chain; other nodes reject unchained edits
Schema mismatch: plain-language fallback line on every record
No network at all: each community runs standalone on its own L0/L1 holdings
backups.in_code: cli.py gaps / order run on one community file with no network

backups.text: Human override always: any community can refuse an AI-proposed exchange
backups.in_code: consent(), state(): one refusal is final

experiments.question: What structural guard stops R1: rotation, multiple independent AI nodes, consent gates?**
experiments.cleanest_test: Tabletop over N rounds with 2+ independent AI nodes and rotating human sign-off; record node_concentration() and how often humans refuse or override.
experiments.null: Concentration and refusal rate are the same with one node as with several: multiplicity is not a guard.

experiments.question: Which low-power comms hold for months: mesh, packet radio, satellite (winter)?
experiments.cleanest_test: Run each channel unattended through a northern winter on its own power; log daily delivery of a fixed test message.
experiments.null: Delivery collapses within weeks on every channel: plan around runners and B1.

experiments.question: Will people under stress send the one line?**
experiments.cleanest_test: During a scheduled outage drill, count FR1/exchange lines sent per task handed out.
experiments.null: Return rate near zero: the loop is open in practice; status must stay UNCONFIRMED-heavy.

experiments.question: How much holdings detail to share vs keep local (R6)?**
experiments.cleanest_test: Same tabletop run at three detail levels (yes/no; coarse bands; quantities); compare match quality against the exposure each level creates.
experiments.null: Yes/no matches as well as quantities: never share quantities.

experiments.question: Which pre-event trust agreements between communities actually hold?
experiments.cleanest_test: Compare drilled vs signed-only vs no agreements in a multi-community exercise; record exchanges completed and refused.
experiments.null: No difference: agreements are paper; build trust some other way.

experiments.question: Matching performance: AI vs human coordinators on the same scenario
experiments.cleanest_test: Identical scenario; arm A uses coordination.py propose, arm B human coordinators only; score gaps closed, time, refusals.
experiments.null: Humans match as well or better: AI layer adds risk (R1-R7) without benefit.

experiments.question: Does manual capability survive with an AI layer present? (added for R5; not in the original list)*
experiments.cleanest_test: Cut the AI layer mid-exercise without warning; time to resume on paper (B1) vs a team that never had it.
experiments.null: Resume time equal: no over-reliance detected.
